module.name: Busbar Snapshot
module.blurb: Create and rotate an OrgSnapshot from a source scratch org.
module.longDescription: Captures a reusable OrgSnapshot from a configured source scratch org, with zero-downtime rotation: the new snapshot is built under a temporary name and only swapped to the canonical name once Active, so the name always resolves to a working snapshot and the operation is safely re-runnable for scheduled golden-snapshot rebuilds.
